title: Self Dividing Numbers
statement: Return all numbers in [left,right] that are divisible by every nonzero digit they contain.

title: Self Dividing Numbers
statement: Return all numbers in [left,right] that are divisible by every nonzero digit they contain.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public List<Integer> selfDividingNumbers(int left,int right){List<Integer>out=new ArrayList<>();for(int x=left;x<=right;x++){int n=x;boolean ok=true;while(n>0){int d=n%10;if(d==0||x%d!=0){ok=false;break;}n/=10;}if(ok)out.add(x);}return out;} }

title: Flood Fill
statement: Starting at a pixel, recolor its four-directionally connected region of the original color.

title: Flood Fill
statement: Starting at a pixel, recolor its four-directionally connected region of the original color.
code: class Solution { public int[][] floodFill(int[][] image,int sr,int sc,int color){int old=image[sr][sc];if(old==color)return image;int m=image.length,n=image[0].length;java.util.ArrayDeque<int[]>st=new java.util.ArrayDeque<>();st.push(new int[]{sr,sc});image[sr][sc]=color;int[]dr={1,-1,0,0},dc={0,0,1,-1};while(!st.isEmpty()){int[]v=st.pop();for(int k=0;k<4;k++){int r=v[0]+dr[k],c=v[1]+dc[k];if(r>=0&&r<m&&c>=0&&c<n&&image[r][c]==old){image[r][c]=color;st.push(new int[]{r,c});}}}return image;} }

title: Find Smallest Letter Greater Than Target
statement: In a sorted character array, return the smallest character strictly greater than target, wrapping to the first character if necessary.

title: Find Smallest Letter Greater Than Target
statement: In a sorted character array, return the smallest character strictly greater than target, wrapping to the first character if necessary.
code: class Solution { public char nextGreatestLetter(char[] letters,char target){int lo=0,hi=letters.length;while(lo<hi){int mid=lo+(hi-lo)/2;if(letters[mid]<=target)lo=mid+1;else hi=mid;}return letters[lo%letters.length];} }

title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
statement: Given the cost of each stair, return the minimum cost to reach beyond the last stair when each move advances one or two steps.

title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
statement: Given the cost of each stair, return the minimum cost to reach beyond the last stair when each move advances one or two steps.
code: class Solution { public int minCostClimbingStairs(int[] cost){int a=0,b=0;for(int i=2;i<=cost.length;i++){int next=Math.min(a+cost[i-2],b+cost[i-1]);a=b;b=next;}return b;} }

title: Largest Number At Least Twice of Others
statement: Return the index of the largest value if it is at least twice every other value; otherwise return -1.

title: Largest Number At Least Twice of Others
statement: Return the index of the largest value if it is at least twice every other value; otherwise return -1.
code: class Solution { public int dominantIndex(int[] nums){if(nums.length==1)return 0;int max=-1,idx=-1,second=-1;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){int x=nums[i];if(x>max){second=max;max=x;idx=i;}else if(x>second)second=x;}return max>=2*second?idx:-1;} }

title: Shortest Completing Word
statement: Return the shortest word containing all letters from a license plate, ignoring digits, spaces, and case.

title: Shortest Completing Word
statement: Return the shortest word containing all letters from a license plate, ignoring digits, spaces, and case.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String shortestCompletingWord(String licensePlate,String[] words){int[] need=new int[26];for(char c:licensePlate.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).toCharArray())if(c>='a'&&c<='z')need[c-'a']++;String best=null;for(String w:words){int[] have=new int[26];for(char c:w.toCharArray())have[c-'a']++;boolean ok=true;for(int i=0;i<26;i++)if(have[i]<need[i]){ok=false;break;}if(ok&&(best==null||w.length()<best.length()))best=w;}return best;} }

title: Prime Number of Set Bits in Binary Representation
statement: Count integers in [left,right] whose binary representation contains a prime number of set bits.

title: Prime Number of Set Bits in Binary Representation
statement: Count integers in [left,right] whose binary representation contains a prime number of set bits.
code: class Solution { public int countPrimeSetBits(int left,int right){int ans=0;for(int x=left;x<=right;x++){int c=Integer.bitCount(x);if(c==2||c==3||c==5||c==7||c==11||c==13||c==17||c==19)ans++;}return ans;} }

title: Toeplitz Matrix
statement: Return true if every diagonal from top-left to bottom-right contains equal values.
approach_name: Compare each cell with its upper-left neighbor

title: Toeplitz Matrix
statement: Return true if every diagonal from top-left to bottom-right contains equal values.
approach_name: Compare each cell with its upper-left neighbor
code: class Solution { public boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] matrix){for(int r=1;r<matrix.length;r++)for(int c=1;c<matrix[0].length;c++)if(matrix[r][c]!=matrix[r-1][c-1])return false;return true;} }

title: Jewels and Stones
statement: Count how many characters in stones are also present in jewels.
approach_name: Count stones present in jewel set
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int numJewelsInStones(String jewels,String stones){Set<Character>j=new HashSet<>();for(char c:jewels.toCharArray())j.add(c);int n=0;for(char c:stones.toCharArray())if(j.contains(c))n++;return n;} }

title: Minimum Distance Between BST Nodes
statement: Return the minimum absolute difference between values of any two distinct nodes in a BST.

title: Minimum Distance Between BST Nodes
statement: Return the minimum absolute difference between values of any two distinct nodes in a BST.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int minDiffInBST(TreeNode root){List<Integer>v=new ArrayList<>();dfs(root,v);int best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int i=1;i<v.size();i++)best=Math.min(best,v.get(i)-v.get(i-1));return best;}private void dfs(TreeNode n,List<Integer>v){if(n!=null){dfs(n.left,v);v.add(n.val);dfs(n.right,v);}} }
